headline: Council recesses meeting because of severe weather, to reconvene at 9 a.m.

meeting.summary: The chair recessed the meeting after roll call, with a quorum confirmed and no vote taken. It reconvenes at 9 a.m. on the same Teams link. A meet-and-greet with a visiting council delegation is set for 4 to 5 p.m.
meeting.recap: The chair called the council meeting to order.[[0:00:00]] Because of severe weather, the chair said the meeting would be recessed after the clerk took roll.[[0:00:21]] The chair said the meeting would reconvene at 9 a.m. at the same Teams link posted for the day's agenda.[[0:00:29]] All members joined online, and the clerk asked each one to say who else was with them.[[0:00:46]] One council member said school was canceled that day, so school-aged children were home.[[0:01:15]] A council member in Kaunakakai reported no testifiers (people signed up to speak) at that location.[[0:01:46]] The vice chair was excused.[[0:02:58]] The clerk reported eight members present and one excused, which is a quorum (enough members to do business).[[0:03:18]] Staff asked the chair to announce that a delegation from the Fukuyama City Council will visit for a meet-and-greet in the council chamber.[[0:03:27]] The meet-and-greet is set for 4 to 5 p.m.[[0:03:42]] All available council members were invited, and light refreshments will be provided.[[0:03:45]] The chair declared the meeting in recess.[[0:04:06]]
decided: The chair declared the meeting in recess; no vote was taken.
meeting.next: The meeting will reconvene at the same Teams meeting link.

moments.q: "So this meeting is now in recess."
